#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent saved-value audit; imports no production analysis helpers."""
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tomllib

ROOT = Path('/Users/masa/git/KagomeDMRG.jl')
OUT = ROOT/'docs/research/data/p4_vbc54_matched_independent_audit.json'
INPUT = ROOT/'outputs/p4-vbc54-matched-20260922/validation.toml'
pins = {}
checks = 0
residuals = []

def verify(condition, label):
    global checks
    checks += 1
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(label)

def close(a, b, label, tol=1e-10):
    error = abs(a-b)
    residuals.append(error)
    verify(math.isfinite(error) and error <= tol, label)

def digest(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute(): p = ROOT/p
    value = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    pins[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] = value
    return value

def read(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute(): p = ROOT/p
    digest(p)
    return tomllib.loads(p.read_text())

def run_audit(path, status, budget):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute(): p = ROOT/p
    r = read(p); e = read(p.parent/'execution.toml')
    verify(r['status']==status and r['sources_unchanged'] and r['backend_unchanged'], 'run completion')
    verify(e['status']=='exited' and e['worker_exit_code']==0 and e['worker_exit_confirmed'], 'outer completion')
    verify(0<=e['wall_elapsed_seconds']<=e['wall_limit_seconds']==r['wall_limit_seconds']==budget,'budget')
    verify(e['julia_threads']==e['blas_threads']==r['runtime']['julia_threads']==r['runtime']['blas_threads']==1,'threads')
    archive=p.parent/'analysis-sources'
    verify(read(archive/'config.toml')==r['config'] and digest(archive/'config.toml')==r['config_sha256'],'configuration archive')
    for name, h in r['analysis_source_sha256'].items():
        verify(digest(archive/name)==h,'archived research source')
    for name, h in r['code']['source_sha256'].items():
        verify(digest(name)==h,'actual backend source')
    for role, h in r['code']['environment_sha256'].items():
        verify(digest(ROOT/'research'/role.split(':',1)[1])==h,'actual dependency environment')
    return r,e

r,e = run_audit(INPUT,'completed_matched_parent_comparison_accuracy_separate',3600)
verify(r['parents_unchanged'],'parent finalization')
g=r['configuration']
verify((g['Lx'],g['Ly'],g['N'],g['Q'],g['gauge'],g['ordering'])==(6,3,54,6,'seam','x_then_y_then_A_B_C'),'geometry')
verify(all(v==0 for v in g['hz']) and len(g['bonds'])==102 and all(b['Jxy']==b['Jz']==1 for b in g['bonds']),'NN zero-field model')
verify(all((s['index'],s['x'],s['y'],s['sublattice'])==(i+1,i//9,(i//3)%3,'ABC'[i%3]) for i,s in enumerate(g['sites'])),'explicit arithmetic site order')
verify([(b['chi'],b['branch']) for b in r['batches']]==list(itertools.product((128,256),('random','windmill'))),'exact four children')
parent_record=read(r['config']['parents'][0]['record'])
pr,pe=run_audit(r['config']['parents'][0]['record'],'completed_preparation_comparison_accuracy_separate',2700)
verify(pr['configuration']==g and pr['runtime']==r['runtime'],'parent/child physical and runtime conventions')
for key in ('source_sha256','environment_sha256','manifest'):
    verify(pr['code'][key]==r['code'][key],'parent/child execution identity')
rows={}; metas={}
for spec in r['config']['parents']:
    name=spec['branch']; p=next(b for b in pr['batches'] if b['branch']==name and b['stage']=='relax')
    saved=r['parents'][name]
    verify(digest(spec['record'])==spec['record_sha256']==saved['record_sha256'],'parent record binding')
    verify(p['checkpoint']==spec['checkpoint']==saved['checkpoint'] and p['cumulative_sweeps']==saved['initial_completed_sweeps']==8,'parent identity')
    verify(p['checkpoint_sha256']==saved['checkpoint_sha256'] and digest(Path(p['checkpoint'])/'metadata.toml')==spec['metadata_sha256'],'parent snapshot binding')
    verify(saved['strict_source_runtime_configuration_load'] and p['settings']==saved['settings'],'strict parent settings')
    close(saved['loaded_energy'],p['energy'],'loaded parent energy')
    rows['parent_'+name]=p
for b in r['batches']:
    name=b['branch']; parent=rows['parent_'+name]
    verify(b['parent_checkpoint']==parent['checkpoint'] and b['parent_record_sha256']==r['parents'][name]['record_sha256'],'child parent link')
    verify(b['cumulative_sweeps']==10 and b['unpinned_sweeps']==(10 if name=='random' else 6),'child sweep histories')
    verify(b['settings']==dict(parent['settings'],maxdim=[b['chi'],b['chi']]),'only maxdim changed')
    verify(b['same_chi_comparison']==(b['chi']==128) and b['parent_profile_unchanged_error']<=1e-12,'fixed parent state')
    rows[str(b['chi'])+'_'+name]=b

for name,b in rows.items():
    run=pr if name.startswith('parent') else r
    cp=ROOT/b['checkpoint'];meta=read(cp/'metadata.toml');c=read(cp/'checksums.toml');metas[name]=meta
    verify({f:digest(cp/f) for f in ('metadata.toml','state.jls','checksums.toml')}==b['checkpoint_sha256'],'checkpoint hash binding')
    for f in ('metadata.toml','state.jls'):
        verify(c['files'][f]==dict(sha256=digest(cp/f),bytes=(cp/f).stat().st_size),'snapshot checksum and length')
    verify(meta['status']=='trial' and meta['theta_path']==[0.0] and meta['configuration']==g==b['model_configuration'],'trial NN model')
    verify(meta['settings']==b['settings'] and meta['settings']['nsweeps']==2,'checkpoint settings')
    verify(meta['runtime']=={k:v for k,v in run['runtime'].items() if k not in ('julia_threads','blas_threads')},'checkpoint runtime')
    for key in ('source_sha256','environment_sha256','manifest'):
        verify(meta['provenance'][key]==run['code'][key],'checkpoint provenance')
    st=meta['state'];verify(st['Q']==6 and st['theta']==0 and st['energy']==b['energy'] and st['sz']==b['sz_profile'],'saved observables')
    verify(st['sweep_energies']==b['sweep_energies'] and st['max_truncation_errors']==b['measured_truncation_errors'],'saved sweep diagnostics')
    verify(b['checkpoint_verified'] and b['checkpoint_overlap_error']<=1e-12 and b['integrity_passed'] and b['lambda']==0,'state integrity flags')
    verify(len(b['sweep_energies'])==len(b['measured_truncation_errors'])==2,'sweep counts')
    close(abs(st['local_energy']-b['energy']),b['last_optimizer_energy_error'],'solver difference')
    close(abs(st['sweep_energies'][-1]-st['sweep_energies'][-2]),b['last_sweep_energy_change'],'last sweep difference')
    sz=b['sz_profile'];c=b['correlations'];zz=c['zz_real'];zi=c['zz_imag'];pm=c['pm_real'];pi=c['pm_imag']
    verify(len(sz)==54 and len(b['bond_energy'])==102 and all(len(m)==54 and all(len(v)==54 for v in m) for m in c.values()),'observable shapes')
    close(math.fsum(sz),3,'charge')
    close(math.fsum(b['bond_energy']),b['energy'],'bond sum',1e-9)
    close(b['HdaggerH_real']-b['energy']**2,b['variance'],'variance arithmetic',1e-9)
    verify(b['variance']>=-b['variance_roundoff_scale'] and abs(b['HdaggerH_imag'])<=b['variance_roundoff_scale'],'physical second moment')
    for i in range(54):
        close(zz[i][i],0.25,'Sz squared diagonal')
        close(pm[i][i],0.5+sz[i],'Splus Sminus diagonal')
        close(math.fsum(zz[i]),3*sz[i],'fixed charge correlation')
        for j in range(54):
            close(zz[i][j],zz[j][i],'ZZ symmetry')
            close(zi[i][j],0,'ZZ reality')
            close(pm[i][j],pm[j][i],'PM real symmetry')
            close(pi[i][j],-pi[j][i],'PM imaginary antisymmetry')
    for k,bond in enumerate(g['bonds']):
        i,j=bond['i']-1,bond['j']-1
        close(b['bond_energy'][k],zz[i][j]+pm[i][j],'NN energy from correlations')
    for d in b['schmidt']:
        prob=d['probabilities'];q=d['left_q'];cut=d['bond']
        close(math.fsum(prob),1,'Schmidt probability normalization')
        mean=math.fsum(p*x/2 for p,x in zip(prob,q));var=math.fsum(p*(x/2-mean)**2 for p,x in zip(prob,q))
        close(mean,d['mean_left_sz'],'Schmidt mean');close(var,d['variance_left_sz'],'Schmidt variance')
        close(-math.fsum(p*math.log(p) for p in prob if p>0),d['entropy'],'Schmidt entropy')
        close(mean,math.fsum(sz[:cut]),'Schmidt density')
        close(var,math.fsum(zz[i][j] for i in range(cut) for j in range(cut))-math.fsum(sz[:cut])**2,'Schmidt correlation variance',1e-9)
verify(all(m['state']['site_indices']==metas['parent_random']['state']['site_indices'] for m in metas.values()),'all site indices unchanged')

limits=dict(energy_per_site=1e-6,sz_profile=1e-4,bond_profile=1e-4,variance_per_site=1e-5,truncation=1e-6)
verify(r['config']['precision']==limits,'five fixed thresholds')
precision={}
for b in r['batches']:
    parent=rows['parent_'+b['branch']]
    vals=dict(energy_per_site=max(abs(b['energy']-parent['energy']),abs(b['sweep_energies'][-1]-b['sweep_energies'][-2]),b['last_optimizer_energy_error'])/54,
              sz_profile=max(abs(a-c) for a,c in zip(parent['sz_profile'],b['sz_profile'])),
              bond_profile=max(abs(a-c) for a,c in zip(parent['bond_energy'],b['bond_energy'])),
              variance_per_site=abs(b['variance'])/54,truncation=b['measured_truncation_errors'][-1])
    precision[str(b['chi'])+'_'+b['branch']]={k:dict(value=v,limit=limits[k],passed=v<=limits[k]) for k,v in vals.items()}
    for k,v in vals.items():
        close(v,b['precision_values'][k],'worker precision arithmetic',1e-12)
        verify((v<=limits[k])==b['precision_passed'][k],'worker precision decision')
    verify(all(v<=limits[k] for k,v in vals.items())==b['all_precision_conditions_passed'],'combined precision')

def key(i,j,w):
    return (i,j,w) if i<j else (j,i,-w)
bond_lookup={key(b['i']-1,b['j']-1,b['wy']):k for k,b in enumerate(g['bonds'])}
verify(len(bond_lookup)==102,'no duplicate bonds')
maps=[]
for shift in range(3):
    sm=[9*(i//9)+3*((i//3+shift)%3)+i%3 for i in range(54)];bm=[]
    for b in g['bonds']:
        i,j=b['i']-1,b['j']-1
        displacement=(j//3)%3+3*b['wy']-(i//3)%3
        new_displacement=(sm[j]//3)%3-(sm[i]//3)%3
        verify((displacement-new_displacement)%3==0,'translation winding integer')
        bm.append(bond_lookup[key(sm[i],sm[j],(displacement-new_displacement)//3)])
    verify(sorted(sm)==list(range(54)) and sorted(bm)==list(range(102)),'translation bijection')
    maps.append((sm,bm))

def stats(v):
    verify(bool(v) and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in v),'finite comparison')
    mean=math.fsum(v)/len(v)
    return dict(count=len(v),mean=mean,rms=math.sqrt(math.fsum(x*x for x in v)/len(v)),max_abs=max(map(abs,v)))

def compare(left,right):
    a,b=rows[left],rows[right];result=dict(energy_change=b['energy']-a['energy'],windows={})
    for edge in (1,2):
        sites=list(range(9*edge,9*(6-edge)));selected=set(sites)
        bonds=[k for k,v in enumerate(g['bonds']) if v['i']-1 in selected and v['j']-1 in selected]
        verify((len(sites),len(bonds))==((36,66) if edge==1 else (18,30)),'same physical support')
        pairs=[(i,j) for i in sites for j in sites if i!=j];all_shifts=[]
        for shift,(sm,bm) in enumerate(maps):
            c={k:stats([b['correlations'][k][sm[i]][sm[j]]-a['correlations'][k][i][j] for i,j in pairs]) for k in ('zz_real','zz_imag','pm_real','pm_imag')}
            c['connected_zz_real']=stats([(b['correlations']['zz_real'][sm[i]][sm[j]]-b['sz_profile'][sm[i]]*b['sz_profile'][sm[j]])-(a['correlations']['zz_real'][i][j]-a['sz_profile'][i]*a['sz_profile'][j]) for i,j in pairs])
            for k in ('zz','pm'):c[k+'_complex_rms']=math.hypot(c[k+'_real']['rms'],c[k+'_imag']['rms'])
            all_shifts.append(dict(y_shift=shift,bond=stats([b['bond_energy'][bm[k]]-a['bond_energy'][k] for k in bonds]),sz=stats([b['sz_profile'][sm[i]]-a['sz_profile'][i] for i in sites]),correlations=c))
        result['windows'][str(edge)]=dict(site_count=len(sites),bond_count=len(bonds),ordered_offsite_pair_count=len(pairs),all_shifts=all_shifts,raw=all_shifts[0],best=min(all_shifts,key=lambda c:(c['bond']['rms'],c['y_shift'])))
    return result

comparisons={}
for stage in ('parent','128','256'):
    comparisons['branch_'+stage]=compare(stage+'_random',stage+'_windmill')
for branch in ('random','windmill'):
    for chi in (128,256):comparisons[f'parent_to_{chi}_{branch}']=compare('parent_'+branch,str(chi)+'_'+branch)
    comparisons['chi128_to_256_'+branch]=compare('128_'+branch,'256_'+branch)
for path,h in list(pins.items()):verify(hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,'input unchanged at finalization')
source=Path(__file__).read_text()
artifact=dict(schema_version=1,status='passed_independent_saved_value_audit',scope='6 snapshots; 20 precision conditions; 9 comparisons times 2 windows times 3 shifts',
    checks=checks,max_arithmetic_residual=max(residuals),mps_recontracted=False,new_dmrg=False,analysis_helpers_imported=False,
    precision=precision,passed_precision_conditions=sum(v['passed'] for d in precision.values() for v in d.values()),comparisons=comparisons,
    input_sha256=pins,runtime=dict(python=sys.version.split()[0]),execution={k:e[k] for k in ('status','wall_elapsed_seconds','wall_limit_seconds','worker_exit_code','worker_exit_confirmed','worker_cpu_total_seconds','worker_peak_rss_bytes')},
    numerical_claim='All children remain unconverged; no converged energy ranking, ground state, bulk phase, or plateau claim.',
    next_resource_decision='Propose one bounded equal additional two-sweep fixed-chi256 continuation from both cumulative10 children to separate fixed-chi relaxation from the already measured chi response; defer geometry/sector expansion.',
    audit_source=source,audit_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest())
with OUT.open('x') as stream:json.dump(artifact,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(output=str(OUT.relative_to(ROOT)),status=artifact['status'],checks=checks,max_arithmetic_residual=artifact['max_arithmetic_residual'],passed_precision_conditions=artifact['passed_precision_conditions'],best_comparisons={k:{e:v['best'] for e,v in c['windows'].items()} for k,c in comparisons.items()}),indent=2))
